description: Open and recently-resolved owner decisions surfaced across AI-driven development sessions on this repo. Hand-maintained by whichever agent or the owner raises or resolves one -- not auto-generated, so it stays honest rather than complete. See dashboard/README.md.

entries.title: Is the two-layer outdoor-venue model the right shape for Phase 5?
entries.detail: Layer 1 (Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles, streamed, key-gated) + Layer 2 (persistent open-data model from AWS Terrain Tiles / USGS NAIP / OpenStreetMap, PR #17). Open question: does "true to life, ultra realistic" mean this owned-geometry-under-streamed-photorealism split, or does the persistent layer itself need to look photographic?

entries.title: Fold the geo-referencing workstream and Phase 0 drift fixes into docs/ROADMAP.md?
entries.detail: The R0-R5 roadmap doesn't currently name the georeferencing/open-data work as its own row, and the stale 186 m anchor references (§1.1's open parity divergence) are documented but not yet tracked as a roadmap item.

entries.title: Delete the icaruslastflight/previs-updade scratch repo?
entries.detail: Assessed as a dead-end (3 commits, no shared history with this repo, stray unrelated .gitattributes) but not deleted without the owner's explicit word.

entries.title: Port the corrected 184.963 m site anchor height to the UE5 georeferencing actor
entries.detail: CLAUDE.md §1.1's open parity divergence: the web anchor was corrected from 186.6 m to 184.963 m (missing NAD83->ITRF2014 frame offset); no equivalent UE5 georeferencing actor exists yet to receive the same fix. Needs a Windows workstation with UE5.8 installed.

entries.title: Shadow PC device pairing and UE5 install
entries.detail: docs/DESKTOP_DEV_SETUP.md's bootstrap script covers everything up to Phase 2 (pairing) and Phase 7 (UE5/Visual Studio) as manual steps -- both still need the owner at the physical/remote desktop session.

entries.resolvedNote: Owner said "proceed"; merged. A later auto-merge attempt on a subsequent PR was blocked by the session's own permission classifier ("Merge Without Review"), so PRs opened after that point are left in draft for explicit review instead of auto-merged.
entries.title: Merge PR #17 (open-data venue showcase) once green?

entries.resolvedNote: Root-caused after the owner reported "my dashboard isnt working": this very file lived at dashboard/data/decisions.json, fetched by main.ts via a bare relative URL. Vite's production build only copies files it can trace (public/ verbatim, or an actual import/new URL()) -- a runtime-only fetch() target isn't one, so npm run dev's filesystem-serving mode kept working locally while the real GitHub Pages deploy 404'd on this exact file the whole time. Moved to public/dashboard/data/decisions.json (no code change needed, relative fetch still resolves) and added a dedicated gate to verify_foundational_setup.sh so npm run build fails loudly instead of shipping a silent 404 if this ever regresses.
